purpose: Reviewed native edge bindings for the generation-only opposite-age Temple probe, tranche 1. Each row names the one native Ship exit that carries the pinned OoTMM entrance; export_oot_bindings.py re-verifies every claim below against the sources and fails on drift.

rows.name: OOT_LAKE_HYLIA_FROM_VALLEY

evidence.text: // scale/boots logic is outside lower stream, as lower stream combines access to lake hylia for entrance randomizer's sake

rows.note: Pinned 'OOT Gerudo Valley Falls' -> 'OOT Lake Hylia' is "true" (data/world/oot/overworld/gerudo_valley.yml:118). Ship's shuffled river exit is the unconditional GV Lower Stream -> Lake Hylia edge; the scale/boots requirement sits on the edges into GV Lower Stream, so deleting this exit removes exactly the falls route.

rows.name: OOT_FIELD_OWL
rows.note: Pinned 'OOT Lake Hylia' -> 'OOT Hyrule Field Drawbridge' is "is_child" (lake_hylia.yml:7). Ship splits the owl into Lake Hylia -> LH Owl Flight (child plus a known language, lake_hylia.cpp:91) and the shuffled flight -> Hyrule Field drop; binding the drop keeps the source condition on the flight edge. Ship has one Hyrule Field region for the drawbridge area.

rows.name: OOT_VILLAGE_OWL
rows.note: Pinned 'OOT Death Mountain Summit' -> 'OOT Kakariko Rooftop' is "is_child" (death_mountain_trail.yml:72). Same owl split as the field owl: the condition stays on summit -> DMT Owl Flight and the bound edge is the flight -> Impa's rooftop drop.

rows.name: OOT_SPAWN_CHILD
rows.note: Root policy only, never a candidate edge in tranche 1. The probe's synthesized root edge RR_ROOT -> RR_CHILD_SPAWN uses the Root Exits condition logic->IsChild, which equals the pinned exprAge(AGE_CHILD) of validateAgeTemple (solver/entrances.ts:270-278); 'OOT SPAWN CHILD' -> "OOT Link's House" is "true" (_system.yml:15).

rows.name: OOT_SPAWN_ADULT

evidence.text: NO_RETURN_ENTRANCE }, // 0x282 is an unused entrance index repurposed to differentiate between

rows.note: Root policy only. OoTMM's 0xf20 is a logical id that loads as 0x5f4 (OotNativeArrival.h playAdjustEntrance alias); Ship repurposes 0x282 for the same adult spawn so it differs from Prelude. The synthesized root edge RR_ROOT -> RR_ADULT_SPAWN uses logic->IsAdult, the pinned exprAge(AGE_ADULT); 'OOT SPAWN ADULT' -> 'OOT Temple of Time' is "true" (_system.yml:21).
